name: Babel
overview: The account of Babel in Genesis 11 reveals a time when humanity shared one language and united in building a city and a tower reaching toward heaven in the plain of Shinar. Their motivation was to make a name for themselves and avoid being scattered across the earth, demonstrating human pride and self-reliance. The LORD observed their work and recognized that with one language and united purpose, nothing they imagined would be impossible to accomplish. To curb their ambitions, God confused their language, causing them to scatter and halting the construction, illustrating divine sovereignty over human plans and the consequences of rebellion against His design.
